concerns.text: T002 mandates a hard pipeline stop when the metallic‑glass subset contains fewer than 50 entries. The specification (US‑1 scenario 1 & SC‑005) requires the system to *proceed* with a warning if fewer than 500 entries are available, treating that as a valid pass condition. Stopping early weakens the functional requirement and violates FR‑001/SC‑005.

The amorphous‑filtering logic in T002 uses MP tags, `structure_type` substrings, and missing space‑group info, whereas FR‑001 explicitly requires filtering via the `material_type` metadata field or the presence of the keyword “glass” in the entry description. Substituting a different detection method can miss valid metallic‑glass entries, constituting a semantic weakening of FR‑001.

The embedded mg_dataset.schema.yaml is malformed (duplicate `vec` property with malformed type declarations and truncated descriptions). Tasks T001–T004 claim verification against this schema, but the schema cannot be parsed, effectively weakening the contract‑validation requirement.
